script: Background checks. Most hires need a background check before they can start. For staff on a requisition, it runs through recruiting automatically. Your part is setting it up correctly on the requisition, and waiting for clearance before you convert.

Set it up on the requisition. In Configuration, choose the background check vendor, HireRight, and the account: V A N zero zero zero for anywhere except New York, and V A N zero nine for New York. Mark Work with minors, Fingerprinting, and Motor vehicle record if the role needs them.

New York has its own order. New York requires non-criminal checks before any conditional offer. New York requisitions must use the New York candidate selection process, which sends the candidate to HireRight when they're selected for offer.

The recruiter picks the packages at the offer. Which checks run depends on the person. For example, an existing employee may only need a motor vehicle record check. So ignore the packages pop-up when you submit the requisition.
The pre-employment background check team, PEBC, marks the check cleared. That creates the pending worker, and PEBC emails you that the person is clear to start.
Then convert the pending worker. Only convert after the clear to start email. PEBC also records citizenship on the application, which you'll need during conversion.
Not on a requisition? For populations hired without a requisition, request the background check manually, through Formstack.
Two things to remember. Work with minors set to Yes adds a protection of minors check. And if you're not sure where a candidate stands, ask central recruiting before you create a direct hire.
